all_events.cypher: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) WHERE r.timestamp IS NOT NULL RETURN a.name AS subject, type(r) AS relationship, b.name AS object, r.timestamp AS timestamp ORDER BY r.timestamp

events_after.description: Retrieve events on or after a given date
events_after.cypher: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) WHERE r.timestamp IS NOT NULL AND r.timestamp >= datetime($start_date + 'T00:00:00') RETURN a.name AS subject, type(r) AS relationship, b.name AS object, r.timestamp AS timestamp ORDER BY r.timestamp

events_between.cypher: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) WHERE r.timestamp IS NOT NULL AND r.timestamp >= datetime($start_date + 'T00:00:00') AND r.timestamp <= datetime($end_date + 'T23:59:59') RETURN a.name AS subject, type(r) AS relationship, b.name AS object, r.timestamp AS timestamp ORDER BY r.timestamp

person_history.description: Retrieve chronological history of a person
person_history.cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name: $person})-[r]->(b) WHERE r.timestamp IS NOT NULL RETURN a.name AS subject, type(r) AS relationship, b.name AS object, r.timestamp AS timestamp ORDER BY r.timestamp

technology_history.description: Retrieve chronological history of a technology
technology_history.cypher: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b:Technology {name: $technology}) WHERE r.timestamp IS NOT NULL RETURN a.name AS subject, type(r) AS relationship, b.name AS object, r.timestamp AS timestamp ORDER BY r.timestamp
